title: Connect a model
body: The model is the brain behind your bot. Pick a free one or paste a key.

title: Send your first message
body: Ask for something small, like a summary of a web page or a short email draft.

title: Try an approval
body: Ask the bot to create a file. It will stop and ask you first; you decide.
bodyFull: Your bot works at the Full level, so it does not ask before ordinary actions. It still stops for the big ones, like setting up a schedule. Ask it to set up a daily reminder and decide on the card.

title: Add an app
body: Apps let the bot work with things like your calendar or notes.

title: Schedule a job
body: Have the bot do something on its own, like a summary every morning.

title: Add a server (optional)
body: A server lets your bots keep working while this computer is off.
